data.standardized_narrative: Unable to extract reliable reserve figures or prior-year movement from the provided scanned images. The report images supplied are low resolution / rotated and OCR text was not available, so no authoritative gross claims outstanding or gross prior-year development figure could be located with confidence.
data.data_quality_notes: The PDF was supplied as scanned page images with rotated pages and low OCR quality. I could not reliably read numeric tables (Balance Sheet technical provisions, the movement in prior years provision note, or the claims development triangle). Therefore all reserve-specific fields are left null. If you can supply a higher-resolution PDF, the original (text) PDF, or crop and provide the Balance Sheet page and the 'Movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' note/table, I can extract the requested values precisely.
